The WEEKDAY BAGEL has a "NEW" marker visible on the menu.

[menu1] Used the image as primary source since the bbox HTML appears to be vector/decorative text and is noisy. Section names normalized to Title Case ("Hot Klassics & Specialties" etc.). The 'KK EXTRAS' add-ons (EXTRA SHOT 20, PLANT BASED MILKS 35, EXTRA SYRUP 20, EXTRA SAUCE 20) were excluded as instructed. No allergen icons were visible on the menu. "NEW" badges identified on: ICED STRAWBERRY LATTE, BLENDED STRAWBERRY MATCHA, BLENDED SALTED CARAMEL MATCHA, OCEAN BREEZE, LOVE STORY, SUNSET. Mojitos and Smoothies sections appear to be single-priced (only one price column visible per row). The "COOOBERRY" spelling preserved as printed (could be COOBERRY - hard to be 100% certain from image resolution, but appears to have 3 O's).

[menu3] Allergen icons (vegan/etc) visible as small symbols in image but not reliably distinguishable via OCR; left empty. SMOKED TO PERFECTION price read as 290 LE (OCR showed both "590.LE" and "290.LE" — 290 is the consistent confident value). SPICY TUNNACADO BAGEL bagel-section price read as 155 LE from image (not in bbox text clearly). SAN SEBASTIAN CHEESECAKE shows Extras list (Pistachio 50, Caramel 45, Chocolate 45) but those are modifier add-ons so excluded per instructions. Mini Cheesecake and Kult Made Cookies were split per flavor variant since each had its own listed price line.
